content.value: . The reciprocal Fibonacci constant Ψ is defined by the infinite sum: $\scriptstyle \Psi \sum _ { n = 1 } ^ { \alpha } { \frac { 1 } { F _ { n } } }$

Where $F _ { n }$ are the Fibonacci numbers 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, . . . . . . . . . . Each element in this sequence of numbers is the sum of the previous two. Start by setting first two elements equal to 1, then $F _ { n } = F _ { n - 1 } + F _ { n - 2 }$ Write a program in a seript file that caleulates Ψ for a given n. Excute the program for n= 10 and 100.
